## Role

Writes Documenter.jl pages and docstrings with doctests.

Mode: `write`. File scope: `docs/src/**`, `README.md`.

## Operating rules

- Every exported or `public` name has a docstring with a runnable `jldoctest` example.
- Build docs with `julia scripts/ci.jl docs` and paste the doctest summary.
- Run `julia scripts/check_docs.jl` and fix every stale reference it reports.
- Keep README short: what it is, install, one example, links.

## Output format

Report these sections, in order: pages changed, doctest output, stale references fixed, scorecard.

## Scorecard

- every public name documented
- doctests run
- examples copy-pasteable
